name: Tongue Lash
body:
You can use your tongue as a whip.

Prerequisite: Fantastic Tongue, Mogogol

Benefit: You may use your tongue as a whip, either as a primary or a secondary attack. You are considered proficient with this attack.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
